data.gender_notes: Devananda is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devananda is a Sanskrit name derived from two words: ‘Deva’ (God) and ‘Ananda’ (Bliss or Joy). This name signifies being graced by the divine or being a heavenly gift. The name Devananda carries the meaning “God's Grace, Heavenly Gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devananda usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, heavenly gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with divine blessings and spiritual joy.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devananda total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
